patthana15.11:1.1: hetuṃ sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.11:2.1: hetuṃ asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.11:3.1: nahetuṃ nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na nevasekkhānāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuduka parittattike nahetuduka parittattikaṃ
